actions.action: Move plant away from radiator and cold drafts to bright indirect light
Group plant with other plants to raise humidity
Set plant on a pebble tray with water
Check top inch of soil and water thoroughly when dry
Empty water collected in decorative outer pot
Flush soil with plain water every month or two
Use filtered or rainwater if tap water is hard
Pause or reduce fertilizer until new growth is healthy
Trim brown tips with clean scissors
Check roots for rot if soil stays soggy

reason: Dry air is listed first and emphasized but only as one of several possible causes of tip necrosis, while the top two fixes (move away from radiator, raise humidity) match what worked, and nothing recommended is harmful.
